mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing the present value of expected returns and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, which raises the cost of capital and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 1% month-over-month for two consecutive months indicates weakening labor demand, which reduces expected corporate earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 1% month-over-month for two consecutive months signals strengthening labor demand, which raises expected corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.2666 for two consecutive months indicates softening supply conditions, which reduces market capacity and increases resource scarcity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 102.2666 for two consecutive months signals improving supply conditions, which increases market capacity and reduces resource scarcity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
